answer: Locks are entered in nadir, expire in dawn, and spiral lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 11 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A hostile operator running 23 aliases thus needs 22 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 3080 identities would post 3244 proofs and burn roughly 66 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
